item.title: Version 0.17.2
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.17.2

What’s New

  • Bulk Close Live Tabs: Right-click a live tab to close other tabs in the same window, the same browser, across all browsers, or close tabs above/below it. Works in both expanded sidebar and compact mode.
  • Smarter Command Panel Suggestions: Search suggestions are now ranked by how closely they match what you typed, so exact and prefix matches surface faster while stale past searches get out of the way.
  • German, Spanish & Japanese Beta Translations: SupaSidebar now includes beta translations for German, Spanish, and Japanese, alongside English and French. You can choose your language in Preferences > General.
  • MCP Connection Status: AI preferences now show the local MCP bridge status, endpoint, setup guide, and restart control, making Claude/Cursor setup easier to diagnose.
  • Command Panel Suggestion Controls: Use the item options menu to remove old searches or recent links from suggestions, delete saved links, or reset ranking for a single item.

Improvements

  • Better Domain Autocomplete: Multi-word searches can now still surface useful base-domain shortcuts, such as matching a saved site from the first word of your query.
  • Localization Coverage: Remaining UI text has been wrapped for localization, bringing French, German, Spanish, and Japanese coverage to 100%.
  • MCP Documentation: The setup guide and troubleshooting docs now match SupaSidebar 0.17.2 and the latest supasidebar-mcp tool set.
  • Better Crash Reports: When SupaSidebar runs into a problem, crashes now produce more detailed reports, so we can identify and fix issues faster.

Bug Fixes

  • Web Preview Typing: Fixed preview browser windows so text fields and pages can receive keyboard input without stealing focus from your active app.
